description: This file defines the Opencart Admin Controller class 'Permission' for handling error-related permission issues within the OpenCart administrative interface. It includes methods for displaying a permission error page, setting page titles, breadcrumbs, and loading common header, footer, and column components.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class handling permission error page in the admin interface.

methods.description: Renders the permission error page, setting up page title, breadcrumbs, and loading header, footer, and column components.
